contracts.beat: SC01 storm — the wave that becomes the seam
contracts.initial: longship SOLFARI beam-on to a hill-high black wave; ASTRID at the steering-oar, OLAF lashed to the mast
contracts.trajectory: the wave curls to break; ASTRID throws her weight on the oar to take it bow-first
contracts.contact: crest hits; where foam should be the water UNRAVELS into a seam of gold light
contracts.consequence: the ship is driven through; for one beat two worlds stack (storm above, desert below)
contracts.final: SOLFARI slews onto an impossible shore under two suns, crew thrown
contracts.raccord: hard cut to the wet sand + the double-sun sky (SC04)
contracts.weaponWoundCostume: no weapons; crew soaked; Olaf grey/failing; no injuries yet
contracts.camera: locked-off wide to a hard push-in on the unravelling crest

contracts.initial: market square mid-trade; ASTRID senses the tone deepen; stalls at the water edge
contracts.trajectory: ASTRID reads the water and SHOUTS the east row off it; crowd surges inland
contracts.contact: the tide walks up the paving, taking the stalls; a cart overturns
contracts.consequence: the row is clear a beat before the water hits — a life saved by the read, not by force
contracts.final: ASTRID braced on dry stone, water lapping her boots, Seth-Nakht watching from safety
contracts.raccord: cut to Seth-Nakht's reaction (he claims the credit) — SC23
contracts.weaponWoundCostume: no weapons; Astrid soaked; star-chart tattoo visible (CANON)
contracts.camera: handheld whip-pan following her call, then a steadicam retreat with the crowd

contracts.beat: SC38 Astrid takes the field / Meryt disarms Seth-Nakht (F8-ACTION)

contracts.initial: SEAM-ROOT; soldiers charge the shifting ground; MERYT and SETH-NAKHT closest; sand/sea convulsing

contracts.beat: SC40 the cost of the line (Börk saves Vigge)
contracts.initial: Norse crew + Seth-Nakht's soldiers throw themselves at the surging tides to buy the readers a window; BÖRK braces his bulk as a living dam; VIGGE behind him
contracts.trajectory: a flood-surge drives through; Börk plants against it so Vigge can scramble up
contracts.contact: the surge takes Börk; Vigge's hand is pulled from his
contracts.consequence: Börk drowns; Vigge reaches the high stone alive — a death that buys the line
contracts.final: Vigge on the rock, reaching back into empty water; TOVE hauls him in
contracts.raccord: cut to the quiet after — Tove's line to Vigge (he chose it) — SC40 dialogue
contracts.weaponWoundCostume: Börk cook's apron over tunic (CANON); no weapons; drowning not gore
contracts.camera: chaotic handheld in the surge, then a still high-angle on the empty water
